attributes.storage_instructions: Cool & Dry: Keep in a cool, dark spot (15°C–20°C). Heat causes chocolate to melt or "bloom" (turn white). Seal Tight: Store in an airtight container after opening to keep them crunchy and prevent them from absorbing kitchen smells. Fridge Tip: In hot weather, refrigerate in a sealed container. Crucial: Let the pack sit at room temperature for 10 minutes before opening to keep the chocolate glossy
